figurative_meaning_en: In mockery, an extremely ignorant person, a great fool
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন রামছাগল যে কিছুই বোঝে না।
example_sentences_in_english: I've never seen two fools like you.
He's such a great fool that he understands nothing.
note: Refers to a stereotypically foolish goat in Bengali folk expression
